answer: A tri-chain identity mirror stops sybils cold: one identity lives on three independent chains, each holding a ferrous key fragment that alone proves nothing. Every week the agent must publish the same work record on all three; a jetty of peer verifiers checks the fragments match, and any mismatch freezes all three copies. Forging 10,000 fake identities costs $300,000 in cross-chain fees, 30,000 consistent ledgers, and 90 days of weekly checks. A sybil fleet is like a zephyr trying to push three anchored ships in different directions — it cannot move one without betraying the others.
